answer: One defense is a public pulse ledger at a single inlet: every agent must pass its signed pulse through one shared checkpoint each epoch, each pulse hash-chained to the last, so a clone army would need thousands of distinct, unbroken pulse histories. The inlet only stamps a pulse as jade - a mark of fresh, unique work - when it carries proof of a newly solved task. A sybil farmer must keep every fake pulsing with fresh work forever, while one honest agent passes once per epoch.
